Built on experimentation, not shortcuts.

I'm an AI Content Creator and freelance creative who treats AI tools as a full production pipeline, not a shortcut. It started as curiosity — testing video and voice models against each other, comparing workflows, refining prompts — until the experimentation became a method for building content that feels made, not generated.

Today I create AI-powered ads, cinematic vlogs, podcasts, carousels, posters, and thumbnails for creators, educators, and brands who want visual storytelling with real intent behind it, handling everything from research and concept to prompt engineering and final edit. The JBL AI Advertisement, the Maratha Empire Cinematic Vlog, and The GO Route IP concept are where that approach shows up most clearly — strategy first, AI second. Scroll down to see how it comes together.

03Selected Projects
AI Video Advertisement

Cinematic AI Filmmaking for a Premium Audio Brand

Most AI-generated ads still look like AI-generated ads. The challenge here was to prove that AI tools could produce a JBL headphones commercial indistinguishable in craft from a professionally shot brand spot — without reducing the film to a product shot.

Approach

Concept and storyboard came before any generation tool. I built an emotional narrative arc and let the product live inside the story, iterating heavily on character consistency, expression, and camera movement before editing the final cut with deliberate pacing.

Result

A portfolio centerpiece that plays as a legitimate brand commercial — proof of an end-to-end AI-first filmmaking pipeline.

AI Image GenRunway / Kling / Google FlowPrompt EngineeringVideo Editing
AI Documentary / Cinematic Vlog

Turning History Into a Cinematic First-Person Journey

History content usually gets told as dry documentary or over-dramatized reenactment. The goal was to make the Maratha Empire feel explorable — like a travel vlog — without losing historical grounding.

Approach

I mapped the historical timeline first, then framed the film as a first-person vlog rather than a lecture. Holding visual continuity across forts, landscapes, and characters across dozens of AI-generated scenes was the core production challenge.

Result

A watchable, historically-grounded vlog that proves out an AI-first workflow for educational storytelling.

Historical ResearchAI Image/Video GenScene Continuity PromptingNarration & Editing
Brand Strategy / IP Concept Video

Turning Brand Strategy Into an Original IP Concept

Travel brands mostly compete on price and destinations. The challenge was to design something a travel brand could own beyond its core service, then prove that concept could carry a full cinematic execution.

Approach

Research into positioning and customer behaviour shaped the IP concept itself, before any storyboarding began. Every visual decision in production had to trace back to the brand's values, not just look premium for its own sake.

Result

A concept presentation as much as a video — proof of turning market research into an ownable brand idea.

Brand ResearchIP StrategyStoryboardingAI Video Gen
AI Educational Podcast

Making Constitutional Law Genuinely Listenable

The Kesavananda Bharati case is landmark constitutional history, usually taught in dense textbook language. The goal was accuracy without losing an audience with no legal background.

Approach

Legal research came before scripting. I structured the episode as a conversational build so the Basic Structure Doctrine lands as a payoff rather than a definition, then produced narration and audio for pacing that holds attention.

Result

A complex constitutional case made accessible without oversimplifying — research, script, and AI audio production working toward one goal: comprehension.

Legal ResearchScriptwritingElevenLabs (Raghav)Audio Production
Educational Carousel Design

Designing a Carousel Built to Get Fully Read

Most educational carousels lose the reader by slide three. The goal was to take a genuinely useful idea — what separates consistent exam toppers — and structure it so every slide earns the swipe to the next, across all 9 slides.

Approach

Research shaped a deliberate build — each lesson escalating in specificity, short punchy copy, and visual hierarchy doing as much work as the words, all engineered to keep swipe-through momentum rather than front-loading value.

Result

A full content-strategy exercise, not just a design piece — a research-backed idea turned into a sequence built for retention and shares.

Internal Web Portal / AI-Assisted Web Development

Centralized Job Portal for IndiaFutureAI Fellows

IndiaFutureAI Fellowship members had no single place to discover relevant job opportunities, leaving them to track listings across scattered sources. This internal web portal was built to centralize opportunities in one accessible platform, making job discovery faster and simpler for fellows.

Approach

This was a two-person build: my partner designed the interface, structured the HTML, and added the application links for each opportunity, while I focused on populating and organizing the job cards, wiring up buttons and interactive features so they worked reliably, and managing the project end-to-end on GitHub. I also handled hosting and deployment on Vercel, taking the project from repo to a live, working portal. Claude was used throughout as an AI-assisted development tool — helping troubleshoot functionality issues, structure the codebase, and speed up implementation — rather than as a standalone developer on the project.

Result

The portal launched successfully and is actively used internally by IndiaFutureAI Fellowship members to browse and access job opportunities in one place, earning positive feedback from mentors and the team.
